title: Mathematics For Integrated Science
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered the weakest and unreliable measure."
The mode is considered the weakest and unreliable measure.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the act of transforming collected data in the forms of graphs and charts in order to make more sense."
Data presentation is the act of transforming collected data in the forms of graphs and charts in order to make more sense.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a way of presenting data in the form of bars on graph."
Bar chart is a way of presenting data in the form of bars on graph.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a field that deals with collection, collation, presentation and analysis of data in order to make inference or deduction or conclusion or generalization."
Statics is a field that deals with collection, collation, presentation and analysis of data in order to make inference or deduction or conclusion or generalization.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those events of an experiment that cannot occur at the same time, naturally."
Mutually exclusive events are those events of an experiment that cannot occur at the same time, naturally.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of finding the differential coefficient of a function and the resulting function is called the desired function."
Differentiation is the process of finding the differential coefficient of a function and the resulting function is called the desired function.
fib: ______ is used in determining rates of change, in determining minimum and maximum values in arithmetic and in determining areas of plane shapes.
Differential calculus is used in determining rates of change, in determining minimum and maximum values in arithmetic and in determining areas of plane shapes.
______ is the ratio of the number of times of the event and the number of total possible outcomes of experiment of the experiment.
Probability of an event is the ratio of the number of times of the event and the number of total possible outcomes of experiment of the experiment.
______ is a way of presenting data on a cycle and frequency polygon is a way presenting data on a graph with successive points joined by straight lines.
Pie chart is a way of presenting data on a cycle and frequency polygon is a way presenting data on a graph with successive points joined by straight lines.
______ is a statement equating two or more quantities.
An algebraic equation is a statement equating two or more quantities.
______ is considered the strongest and most reliable measure of central location followed by the median.
The mean is considered the strongest and most reliable measure of central location followed by the median.
______ is a way of presenting data in the form of pictures.
Pictogram is a way of presenting data in the form of pictures.
